App._comment: PublicBaseUrl = the externally reachable HTTPS origin of this app (no trailing slash). Telegram webhooks are registered as {PublicBaseUrl}/api/integrations/telegram/webhook/{connectionId}. Required for local testing (use an https tunnel URL); on Render set App__PublicBaseUrl. If empty, the current request's host is used unless it is localhost.

Embeddings._comment: Knowledge Base embeddings (OpenAI-compatible /embeddings). ApiKey is a secret — set it via user-secrets or the Embeddings__ApiKey env var, never here. Dimensions must equal the vector(N) size of knowledge_chunks.embedding in Database/schema.sql.

Knowledge._comment: DEFAULTS ONLY — used to create a clinic's knowledge_search_settings row the first time it's needed (chunk chars ÷ 4 = tokens). After that the clinic's persisted settings (Knowledge Base → Settings) are what's used. ChunkMinChars is a system-wide value not stored per clinic.

N8n._comment: Shared secret n8n must send as the X-Ingest-Key header on POST /api/messages/ingest. Keep the real value out of this file (checked into the repo) — set it via `dotnet user-secrets set "N8n:IngestApiKey" "..."` instead; user-secrets overrides whatever is here.
